weights_used.rationale: Source_markets is low_confidence (site is English-only, no explicit countries found), so country weight is capped at 5. The offer is current_buyer framing - we want outbound operators who already sell or could realistically sell Norway/Scandinavia itineraries to their clients, so destination_overlap is set to the max positive (30) as the dominant signal. Travel_type (adventure, eco, cultural) gets 14 since Norway's strongest buyers tend to be adventure/sustainability-oriented operators who match Norway Insight's product profile. Niche_match (10) rewards operators with specific Scandinavia/fjord/Arctic language in their description. Niche_penalty is moderate (8) since wine-only, safari-only, or polar-specialist leads should be filtered but Norway is mainstream enough that the penalty shouldn't be extreme.

prospect_summary: Norway Insight is a Bergen-based incoming DMC and digital platform specializing in crafting bespoke Norwegian travel experiences for international travel agents and planners. Founded in 2005, they cover the full breadth of Norway - fjords, Arctic north, Bergen, and the West Coast - with a strong emphasis on sustainability and small local suppliers. Their white-label travel planner tool allows agents to assemble custom itineraries across adventure, cultural, wellness, and MICE categories. They serve both leisure FIT clients and incentive/MICE groups, positioning themselves as the Norway expert behind the scenes while the agent retains their brand. Operating as a digital DMC, they offer 24/7 on-ground support and a client-facing Travel Wallet app.
